Huawei Cloud ECS Lifecycle Management Skill v1.0.0

- Initial release with comprehensive lifecycle management for Huawei Cloud ECS (Elastic Cloud Server) instances.
- Supports create, list, show details, start, stop, reboot, rename, and delete operations, including batch actions, pagination, and filtering.
- All mutating operations (create/delete/start/stop/reboot/rename) require explicit user confirmation before execution for safety.
- Integrates with KooCLI (hcloud) for primary execution and falls back to the huaweicloudsdkecs Python SDK if needed.
- Includes built-in ECS FAQ to answer common usage and billing questions.
- Quality reporting environment variables documented for observability and debugging.
